description: Competition entry lifecycle shared by contestant and organizer. Registration preparation and in-app participant updates run as bound n8n state tasks. Human decisions and responses remain external events; no email, PIN or automatic judging is implied.

OPEN.description: An entry has not yet been registered. The contestant submits entry details and a walkthrough video; template publication may still be pending.

SUBMISSION_RECEIVED.description: The registration adapter records the submission and participant assertions. A published workflow ID is optional.

REGISTERED.description: Registration is recorded. The preparation task checks its saved publication evidence and returns the next event.

PUBLICATION_PENDING.description: The contestant has submitted a template to creators.n8n.io, but publication and the workflow ID are still pending.

WORKFLOW_LINKED.description: The preparation task returns the published workflow evidence saved with registration.

WAITING_FOR_PUBLICATION.description: Registration is saved while the template awaits publication. The participant links the published workflow from the workbench when it is available.

WORKFLOW_LINKED.description: The organizer verifies the published workflow and records its ID against the matching entry. Publication is separate from contest acceptance.

ADMIN_REVIEW.description: The organizer checks the linked template, video and eligibility; the human jury reviews the entry. Missing evidence can be requested without discarding registration.

INFORMATION_REQUESTED.description: The organizer records a specific question or missing evidence for the contestant.

FINALIST_SELECTED.description: The human jury selects this entry and the organizer records its finalist invitation. The organizer must enforce the competition-wide limit of three finalists outside this per-entry machine.

NOT_SELECTED.description: The human jury records that this entry was not selected as a finalist.

ENTRY_DISQUALIFIED.description: The organizer records an eligibility failure and its supporting reason.

NEEDS_INFORMATION.description: The contestant supplies the requested clarification. The adapter retains corrected video, workflow and eligibility evidence with the existing entry.

INFORMATION_PROVIDED.description: The contestant's response and any updated evidence are recorded for organizer review; responding does not itself establish eligibility.

INVITED.description: The organizer has selected this entry as a finalist. The participant receives an in-app invitation and explicitly accepts or declines.

CONFIRMED.description: The finalist has confirmed participation. The organizer records attendance for live judging; no date or absence is inferred automatically.

CHECKED_IN.description: The organizer records that the finalist is present and ready for the live competition.

NO_SHOW_RECORDED.description: The organizer explicitly confirms nonattendance; this proposed demo outcome is not emitted by a timer.

JUDGING.description: The finalist participates in live judging. Human judges determine the result; AI has no authority to select finalists or winners.

WINNER_SELECTED.description: The organizer records the human jury's winner decision. Competition-wide winner uniqueness must be checked outside this per-entry machine.

RUNNER_UP_SELECTED.description: The organizer records that this finalist did not win.

AWAITING_PRIZE_ACCEPTANCE.description: The winner has been selected and the organizer awaits prize acceptance. Acceptance does not assert that delivery or payment has occurred.

PRIZE_ACCEPTANCE_EXPIRED.description: The organizer explicitly records expiry after checking the applicable acceptance deadline and any response. This graph has no automatic timer and does not select a replacement winner.

CLOSED.description: The entry's final outcome is recorded. Other entries and competition-wide administration remain separate.
